name: MyWeather
description: MyWeather web version: Chennai and Tamil Nadu weather, as a home-screen web app.

WEATHER_API_KEY.description: Wunderground (api.weather.com) key. Stays on the server; the page never sees it. Optional: without it, enter a key on the Wunderground screen.

WAQI_TOKEN.description: WAQI token for api.waqi.info, kept on the server. Optional.
